commanderCards.name: The Mimeoplasm
commanderCards.oracleText: As The Mimeoplasm enters, you may exile two creature cards from graveyards. If you do, it enters as a copy of one of those cards with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to the power of the other card.

strategy: Build toward turn-six-or-later wins through graveyard-fueled combat, large Mimeoplasm copies, and Living Death rather than an early infect knockout or compact combo. These changes improve early ramp, graveyard setup, repeatable card advantage, and colored mana while preserving meaningful interaction and independent reanimation. Cyclonic Rift, Survival of the Fittest, and Gifts Ungiven occupy the three designated Game Changer slots; Yawgmoth's Will is removed rather than retained alongside them. This is an upper-end Bracket 3 build, with no extra turns, mass land denial, or added infinite combos; its powerful tutor openings should not be used to pursue pre-turn-six eliminations.

research.summary:
## 1. Main strategies/archetypes

- **Self-mill reanimator/toolbox:** fill your graveyard, reanimate valuable creatures, and use The Mimeoplasm as a flexible threat. This is the central strategy; mill, graveyard, and dredge builds overlap heavily.
- **Voltron/infect:** copy an evasive or infect creature, using another creature’s enormous power to supply +1/+1 counters.
- **Graveyard combo:** assemble Necrotic Ooze or reanimation-based combo packages.
- **Secondary themes:** +1/+1 counters and Ooze typal—both represented, but not necessary to the commander’s core plan. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/the-mimeoplasm))

## 2. Key synergy cards and engines

| Role | Specific cards |
|---|---|
| **Find and stock the graveyard** | **Entomb**, **Buried Alive**, **Survival of the Fittest**, **Fauna Shaman** |
| **Mill while improving your hand** | **Grisly Salvage**, **Frantic Search**, **Fact or Fiction**, **Stitcher's Supplier**, **Mesmeric Orb** |
| **Independent reanimation** | **Reanimate**, **Animate Dead**, **Necromancy**, **Victimize**, **Living Death**—important so the deck does not depend entirely on its commander |
| **Large counter donors** | **Lord of Extinction**, **Consuming Aberration**, **Yargle and Multani**, **Death's Shadow** |
| **Useful copy targets** | **Skithiryx, the Blight Dragon**, **Blighted Agent**, **Titanoth Rex**, **Woodfall Primus** |
| **Long-game resources** | **Life from the Loam**, **Muldrotha, the Gravetide**, **Underrealm Lich** |

These recur across current EDHREC recommendations and dedicated deckbuilding articles; select targets according to your chosen win condition rather than including every package. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/the-mimeoplasm?utm_source=openai))

## 3. Popular combos and finishing combinations

| Exact cards | Setup and result |
|---|---|
| **Necrotic Ooze + Phyrexian Devourer + Triskelion** | Ooze on the battlefield; the other two in graveyards. Exile library cards to put counters on Ooze, then remove counters to deal damage. **Potentially table-lethal, but finite**, limited by the remaining library’s total mana value—not genuinely infinite. |
| **Mikaeus, the Unhallowed + Triskelion** | Both on the battlefield. Remove counters for damage, reserving two shots to kill Triskelion itself; undying returns it. **Infinite damage and death/enter/leave triggers.** |
| **Kederekt Leviathan + Animate Dead** | Reanimate Leviathan; its trigger returns other nonland permanents, including Animate Dead, to hand, causing Leviathan’s sacrifice. **Repeatable nonland-board reset for {1}{B} each iteration**, not a free infinite loop. |
| **Hermit Druid + Thassa's Oracle** | With **no basic lands in your library**, an active Druid mills everything for {G}; cast Oracle from hand for {U}{U}. **Wins the game.** |

Commander Spellbook documents these sequences and their prerequisites. ([commanderspellbook.com](https://commanderspellbook.com/combo/1495-1656-4899/?q=card:%22Triskelion%22))

**Commander-specific finisher:** The Mimeoplasm copying **Blighted Agent**, with **Yargle and Multani** supplying 18 counters, becomes a **19/19 unblockable infect creature**—lethal to one opponent if it connects, but it still needs haste or a turn cycle. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/articles/slimer-voracious-apparition-commander-deck-tech?utm_source=openai))

## 4. Common mistakes / underperformers

- **Treating The Mimeoplasm as repeatable reanimation:** it **exiles both cards**. Preserve essential combo pieces, and run separate reanimation spells. It copies only **one** creature’s abilities; the second supplies counters, not keywords. ([media.wizards.com](https://media.wizards.com/2022/wpn/marketing_materials/2x2/EN_MTG2X2_Release%20Notes_20220418.pdf))
- **Keeping outdated, low-impact creatures:** a February 2026 precon rebuild specifically cuts or criticizes **Dark Hatchling**, **Slipstream Eel**, and **Triskelavus**. **Grave Pact** also contributed little without sufficient sacrifice support. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/articles/devour-for-power-commander-precon-remastered?utm_source=openai))
- **Dredging without enough actual draw:** **Golgari Grave-Troll** is powerful, but one budget analysis cut it because the list could not support consistent dredging. That is a build-dependent warning, not a universal cut. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/articles/from-the-brim-to-the-trim-melting-opponents-faces-with-a-budget-reanimator-deck))
- **Assuming raw size is enough:** giant creatures still need evasion; **Jumbo Cactuar**, for example, requires additional help to push damage through. ([cloudflare.edhrec.com](https://cloudflare.edhrec.com/articles/slimer-voracious-apparition-commander-deck-tech?utm_source=openai))

## 5. Mana base advice specific to The Mimeoplasm

- **Practical starting point: 36–38 lands**, then tune downward only with a genuinely low curve and substantial acceleration. Prioritize early **green**, while reliably assembling **{2}{B}{G}{U}**; the 2026 rebuild uses 37 lands and favors land ramp. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/articles/devour-for-power-commander-precon-remastered?utm_source=openai))
- Favor **Command Tower**, **Exotic Orchard**, and efficient colored lands such as **Llanowar Wastes**, **Yavimaya Coast**, and **Underground River** over excessive slow or colorless utility lands. **Cephalid Coliseum** is particularly synergistic as a draw/discard outlet. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/articles/devour-for-power-commander-precon-remastered?utm_source=openai))
- **Choose the Hermit Druid plan before building the lands.** Normal reanimator lists can retain basics and use **Cultivate**, **Kodama's Reach**, and **Sakura-Tribe Elder**; the deterministic Oracle combo instead requires no basics remaining in the library. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/articles/devour-for-power-commander-precon-remastered?utm_source=openai))

combosOneAway.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

Cause one or more opponents to lose life.
Mindcrank triggers once for each life loss event, causing that player to mill cards equal to the amount of life lost.
Bloodchief Ascension triggers once for each card milled, causing that player to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life for each trigger.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Duskmantle Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{U}{B}, causing your opponent to lose life whenever a card is put into their graveyard this turn.
Activate Duskmantle Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{B}, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Duskmantle Guildmage triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to lose 1 life.
Mindcrank triggers, causing the opponent to mill a card.
Duskmantle Guildmage triggers, causing the opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 5 until the opponent has a life total of zero, causing them to lose the game.
Repeat from step 2 for each other opponent.

produces: Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
Return all cards from your graveyard to your hand
Infinite casts of instants and sorceries in your hand and graveyard
combosOneAway.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Eternal Witness and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Eternal Witness tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness and all other creatures you control, adding {B} for each creature sacrificed.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creatures from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return the exiled cards to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat any number of times.

If Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it, activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until there are two +1/+1 counters remaining on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from Triskelion, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 3 an additional time.
Triskelion dies.
Triskelion's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Jumbo Cactuar, causing each opponent to lose 10,000 life.

Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, causing it to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until Wall of Blood's power is equal to the highest life total among your opponent.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Wall of Blood, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Wall of Blood's power.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

produces: Infinitely large creature until end of turn

Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting any creature you control except the creature that has Lightning Greaves attached.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's equip ability.
Repeat.

Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

produces: Return all nonland permanents to owner's hand each turn
combosOneAway.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Kederekt Leviathan from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Kederekt Leviathan triggers, returning all nonland permanents to their owner's hands.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kederekt Leviathan.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Phyrexian Devourer's second ability by exiling the top card of your library, causing you to put a number of +1/+1 counters on Phyrexian Devourer equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 until Phyrexian Devourer's power is greater than each opponent's life total.
Phyrexian Devourer's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Phyrexian Devourer, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Phyrexian Devourer's power.

Cast Hatred by paying {3}{B}{B} and by paying life equal to the highest life total among your opponent, causing any other creature you control to get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the life paid this way.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing the creature, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the creature's power.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Triskelion.
Repeat.

produces: Destroy each creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control
Destroy any number of creatures opponents control
combosOneAway.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
Triskelion triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's ability, attaching it to Cephalid Aristrocrat.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat.

Activate Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 1 an additional 2 times, killing Triskelion.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Triskelion to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Repeat.

Give Triskelion lifelink.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

Give Triskelion deathtouch.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat from step 2.

synergies.title: Build Your Own Giant
synergies.explanation: Buried Alive puts both creatures into your graveyard, letting The Mimeoplasm copy Titanoth Rex and use Lord of Extinction's graveyard-scaled power for additional +1/+1 counters. The result is an enormous trampling commander that can threaten lethal commander damage.

synergies.title: Unblockable Commander Clock
synergies.explanation: Whispersilk Cloak makes a counter-loaded The Mimeoplasm unblockable while protecting it from targeted removal. This turns the commander's huge size into a reliable commander-damage threat rather than something opponents can repeatedly chump-block.

synergies.title: Tutor Into Teamwide Flying
synergies.explanation: Survival of the Fittest can find Wonder, then discard it to another activation while tutoring a useful creature. With Breeding Pool providing the Island subtype, leaving Wonder in your graveyard gives The Mimeoplasm and your other creatures flying.

synergies.title: Graveyard-Sized Table Drain
synergies.explanation: Lord of Extinction turns the deck's graveyard filling into enormous power, and Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord converts that power into life loss for every opponent. This provides a potentially lethal finish without needing to attack.

synergies.title: Cash Out, Dig Deep
synergies.explanation: Greater Good sacrifices a huge The Mimeoplasm to generate cards equal to its power, then discard three cards. Underrealm Lich replaces each draw with selecting one of three cards and putting the other two into your graveyard, producing both exceptional selection and a massive refill of reanimation targets.

synergies.title: Wipe, Then Recruit
synergies.explanation: Life's Finale destroys the creature board and stocks one opponent's graveyard with up to three creatures chosen from their library. A subsequent Sepulchral Primordial can steal one of those curated targets and creatures from the other opponents' newly stocked graveyards.

synergies.title: Turn One Body Into Two
synergies.explanation: Sacrificing Yavimaya Elder to Victimize triggers its land-search ability while returning two creatures from your graveyard. Returning Solemn Simulacrum as one of them adds another land to the battlefield and leaves behind a creature that replaces itself when it dies.

synergies.title: Renewable Shroud Fuel
synergies.explanation: Sylvan Safekeeper turns lands into protection for The Mimeoplasm or another key creature, while Life from the Loam returns those sacrificed lands to your hand. Verdant Catacombs is another reusable land target, and dredging Life from the Loam also advances the graveyard plan.

synergies.title: Windfall Feeds the Monsters
synergies.explanation: Casting Windfall triggers Consuming Aberration's opponent-milling ability, then resolving it puts opponents' discarded hands into their graveyards. Those cards enlarge Consuming Aberration and give Vulturous Zombie a +1/+1 counter for each card entering an opponent's graveyard.

synergies.title: Low-Cost Dredge Reload
synergies.explanation: With Golgari Grave-Troll in your graveyard, replace a Frantic Search draw with dredge 6, then discard the returned Troll during the spell's discard step to prepare another dredge. Untapping up to three lands keeps mana available while you load the graveyard for The Mimeoplasm and reanimation.
